name: Phase 0 study measuring drug concentration at the infiltrating margin

design.intervention: the candidate drug given before surgery, with and without ultrasound barrier opening
design.comparator: core versus margin tissue within each patient
design.readout: drug concentration and a pharmacodynamic marker of target engagement in core and margin tissue

discriminates: Adequate concentration at the margin with no pharmacodynamic effect would show the drug is the problem; inadequate concentration would show delivery is, and would tell the field whether barrier opening actually reaches the margin.

requires: a neurosurgical centre with phase 0 infrastructure

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
